description: For every first-order structure \(M\), free-variable assignment \(a\), one-placeholder scoped body \(A\), and placeholder-free term \(t\), the capture-safe instance satisfies \(M,a\models A(t)\) if and only if \(M,a,(\llbracket t\rrbracket^M_a)\models A\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderProofs.instantiate_realize.{u, v, w, u_1} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {α : Type w}
  {M : Type u_1} [L.Structure M] (φ : L.BoundedFormula α 1) (t : L.Term α) (a : α → M) :
  (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderProofs.instantiate φ t).Realize a ↔
    φ.Realize a fun x => FirstOrder.Language.Term.realize a t
